description: Scrape job listings aggregated across Google Jobs.

chips.description: Extra query filters from the Google Jobs UI.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to geo-target results (e.g. us, gb, in, de). (API default: us)

domain.description: Country-specific Google domain (e.g. google.co.uk, google.co.in). (API default: google.com)

language.description: Result language, e.g. en_us. (API default: en_us)

next_page_token.description: Token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

name: google_jobs
title: Google Jobs API
